heading: From business need to working software.

children.heading: AI-Augmented Delivery
children.text: I blend years of technical depth with AI to accelerate development while staying accountable for the result. AI doesn't eliminate the need for expertise. It increases the leverage of expertise.

children.heading: Workflow Improvement
children.text: Turn scattered requests and manual steps into tools that make work easier to capture, track, and complete.

children.heading: Technical Judgment
children.text: Choose boundaries and abstractions that fit the problem, with attention to reliability, support, and future changes.

children.heading: Delivery Ownership
children.text: Clarify priorities, work through changing requirements, and use AI assistance with deliberate review and verification.
